title: Whore
summary: WHORE, noun Hore. [G. The correct orthography is hore.] A harlot; a courtesan; a concubine; a prostitute. WHORE, verb intransitive [supra.] To have unlawful sexual commerce; to practice lewdness. WHOR

inlines.v: WHORE, noun Hore. [G. The correct orthography is hore.] A harlot; a courtesan; a concubine; a prostitute. WHORE, verb intransitive [supra.] To have unlawful sexual commerce; to practice lewdness. WHORE, verb transitive To corrupt by lewd intercourse. [Little used.]
